commit.message:
fix(updater): re-validate the desktop version policy before installing a downloaded update (#4761)

* fix(updater): re-validate the desktop version policy before installing a downloaded update

A downloaded update stayed installable after the organization revoked its
version from allowedDesktopVersions. Refresh the desktop config before
bridge.installAndRestart() and re-run the allow decision on the downloaded
version; a revoked version is not installed and the update returns to the
blocked-by-policy state so the user can check again. An absent allowlist
still means unrestricted, and a failed refresh (offline) falls back to the
last known config instead of blocking on a network error.

* test(evals): key the revoked-update witness to the installed version

* test(updater): await dialog dismissal and keep refreshed branding

* test(updater): isolate manual retries from background policy refreshes

* test(cdp): support labeled switches in updater journeys
